36.Genre: adventure with fighting and puzzle elements
36.Name: Testing

StartText.0: You are in for a dangerous mission. You will get all the details from the agent of planet <FromPlanet>, whom you will meet shortly.
StartText.1: You are expected at the palace -- to serve Prince Tardym Ka'Boom and his wife at a reception dinner and invite them to planet <FromPlanet>.
StartText.10: Do you remember your childhood dream of becoming a president? Well, your dream may yet come true! You are here to run for president of planet <CurPlanet>. President <Player> -- sounds cool, eh?!
StartText.11: You have the rare chance of receiving an honorary faeyan rank of elunie. To accomplish this you must win the local Elus tournament.
StartText.12: Have you reconsidered the prospect of smuggling fariolas? If not, contact our agents from planet <FromPlanet>, and let's go!
StartText.13: You must participate in a foncer racing tournament that's currently underway on planet <CurPlanet>. A <FromPlanet> representative is waiting for you at the spaceport.
StartText.14: Have you forgotten about your promise to the pelengs from <FromPlanet> to hack the Macrohard server in the GuideNet network? Waste no more time then!
StartText.15: You must conduct field tests of some device. Contact the Institute for Inventions and Innovations.
StartText.16: You must attend the Divine Dispute ritual of vrell-warrior initiation on behalf of planet <FromPlanet>.
StartText.17: You will need to battle through some bureaucracy to get a special permit for planet <FromPlanet>. Then again, could a true ranger be scared off by paperwork?!
StartText.18: An Iike-Baana champion, a gaal named Mo'oron, is expected to return home but now he's stuck here on planet <CurPlanet>. It would be one thing if his business here were important, but he's just playing games! He has actually proclaimed himself an Archmage, I kid you not... And who could help in a situation like this if not Ranger <Player> -- the finest mage tamer in the Galaxy!
StartText.19: Your childhood dream of participating in a hyper-rock live concert is about to come true! All you have to do is form a hyper-rock band with the money provided by planet <FromPlanet>, which is awaiting you at the hotel. And don't forget to check your mail!
StartText.2: You must conduct tests of the latest maloq stealth plane. What's so amoral about this?
StartText.20: You've agreed to coach a team of clerks from planet <FromPlanet> for the upcoming Clerks Without Borders competition. What nonsense! Then again, you've engaged in far more ludicrous activities in the past. Oh well, where are those losers?!
StartText.21: You must undergo a sacred peleng ritual so that Madam President of planet <FromPlanet> could change her sex. One must wonder how this ritual works?
StartText.22: You need to solve a little problem for the local amusement park. All the details of the operation codenamed Fried Chick will be provided on location.
StartText.23: You must help a group of archeologists get into some pharaoh's tomb. Easy does it for a real ranger like yourself, yes? Even easier than breaking into a bank safe!
StartText.24: You must contact the nearest Certification Center on Planet <CurPlanet> to get the Z-45/6a category certificates, granting the right to pilot SLK-5 Shuttlon cargo liners.
StartText.25: You must finish in the top three at the local pizza-cooking tournament.
StartText.26: You must repair a DND disk player at the Museum of Faeyan Technology. Shouldn't be that difficult, right? Of course, you have only a very vague idea of what a DND disk is...
StartText.27: An Intergalactic Tournament of combat robots awaits! The tournament is potentially deadly, but winning it is considered a great honor. Have you reconsidered yet? Then off you go to the organizational committee!
StartText.28: The army draft on planet <CurPlanet> is at risk of being foiled! Dodgers and pacifists have gotten out of control, sowing all manner of chaos. Perhaps military commander <Player> could restore iron discipline and get the draftees of planet <CurPlanet> back in check?
StartText.29: Planet <CurPlanet> is hosting the finals of the hyperjumping plasma checkers galactic tournament. Did you forget about your role in it? It's time for you to head to the local sports center.
StartText.3: You must eliminate the base of Lyakusha Borzukhan. Find a camp of <FromPlanet> agents; they will brief you on the details.
StartText.30: A ski resort awaits! We'll show the local oafs what real management is all about!
StartText.31: You must get a sample of a drug called Swarokox for planet <FromPlanet>. Only the maloqs aren't keen on selling it. Which means you will have to get it some other way... But how?
StartText.32: Who could help investigate the murder of two xenologists on an unpopulated planet? None other than <Player> himself -- renowned ranger by day, private detective by night!
StartText.33: You are here on planet <CurPlanet> with a most noble mission -- rescuing the animals in the xenopark of Mr. Brigee Bardozze. Make haste before the poor things die of hunger!
StartText.34: You're tasked with improving the sales of a local gaming magazine.
StartText.35: Help Nevits & Gnick with a secret project... You'll get all the necessary information on location.
StartText.36: Help Elementar Games to test their brand new masterpiece. You just can't miss such an opportunity!
StartText.37: You need to seize power on a "backward" planet using modern technology. Show the world your evil genius!
StartText.38: You're expected on <CurPlanet> planet, <CurStar> system. You must take part in an annual Baraboom Championship and win the grand prize -- the Baraboom Cup. Afterward you must advertise the game all over as the cleverest game in the Universe. Not a difficult task for a clever ranger like you.
StartText.39: Do you like fishing? If so, then you can look forward to some sunlight, crystal-clear waters, a gentle breeze, a brand new fishing rod and plenty of fish.
StartText.4: Is this the place where they'll hold the Citadels tournament that you've agreed to participate in? Find Jean Pourmesome -- he will fill you in.
StartText.40: Your objective is to sign a contract for the production of new type of weapon called qsetvoemitter, which can help in the fight against dominators.
StartText.41: Help the staff of the Space Exploration History Institute on planet <CurPlanet> (<CurStar> system) with their research. You'll get all the necessary information on location.
StartText.42: Help the government of planet <FromPlanet> procure secret data, collected by a peleng special agent before he was confined to a faeyan loony bin.
StartText.43: You need to defeat the Galaxy's top artists in a tournament. As they say, a man with a talent for something has a talent for everything... You have a unique chance to personally prove or disprove this notion.
StartText.44: You must open a special safe containing the skull of the Great Malokrh Rammor Zakkarad, which is required for a ceremony.
StartText.45: A peleng military base needs a new chief cargo sorter. Please submit your candidacy to: planet <CurPlanet>, <CurStar> system, Milky Way Galaxy.
StartText.46: Head a settler colony on an empty planet to transform a small village into a modern and prosperous city.
StartText.47: Prevent pirates from planet <CurPlanet> in the <CurStar> system from accomplishing their goals to build a new type of large pirate ship.
StartText.48: Your objective is to improve the planet's economy by working as a guide for VIP tourists. Networking possibilities are endless A worthy task for a worthy ranger.
StartText.49: Stop religious fanatics from the Dominator Witnesses sect. Hurry before it's too late!
StartText.5: You are expected at the OpSec department of the local government. After all, you've arrived here as an expert diver from planet <FromPlanet>. What mission will they have for you this time?
StartText.50: Prevent organized crime from prospering on planet <CurPlanet> in the <CurStar> system. The Dzuhallag Deterrence Department believes in you!
StartText.51: Find a power station in the mouth of a volcano on a small island on planet <CurPlanet> and come back for your paycheck. Anything unclear about that?
StartText.52: Help a research expedition to install an Edelweiss radio transmitter, but be on your guard! There won't be any help on an empty planet.
StartText.53: Steal a stealth ship prototype from a peleng base on planet <CurPlanet> in the <CurStar> system.
StartText.54: Take part in a reconnaissance mission to learn the origin of mutant animals that are threatening nearby planets.
StartText.55: Get to the bottom of strange phenomena happening in the Utility mining complex.
StartText.56: Lead your team to victory in the Oldsmobile racing competition.
StartText.57: An expedition sent to planet <CurPlanet> (<CurStar> system) is in big trouble. Go there and help the scientists.
StartText.58: You need to help the owner of a local transportation company to expand his business.
StartText.59: You were given an exclusive task that requires you to learn to drive an ancient mode of transportation -- an automobile.
StartText.6: You were employed by a local environmental organization called Greenjoy for diving work.
StartText.60: You need to procure a disk containing sensitive information and deliver it to your employer.
StartText.61: Framing innocents is right up your alley! You have mastered the art of deflecting blame for stolen candy early in life; this is more or less the same thing, only a bit more far-reaching. So, let's begin?
StartText.62: An expert on hyperspace consoles from the Umbrotech corporation has disappeared under mysterious circumstances. You have been asked to take his place. Are you willing to put your life at risk? Then this task is for you!
StartText.63: You need to win first place in the first Galactic Open Doomino Tournament.
StartText.64: You need to procure important documents from the branch manager of an animation studio and deliver them to your employer.
StartText.65: Your task is to locate a superserver on planet <CurPlanet> and restore the computer forum's function.
StartText.66: You need to learn the fate of a science expedition gone missing on an unpopulated planet.
StartText.67: You were asked to help Professor Dord with a long-desired promotion to Galactic Academic.
StartText.68: Communication broke with a science expedition deployed on planet <CurPlanet> in the <CurStar> system. You must aid the fearless explorers of unpopulated planets!
StartText.69: You need to protect an innocent party from judicial abuse.
StartText.7: You need to find the wife of Rolan -- nephew to the Speaker of planet <FromPlanet>. Rolan got himself into yet another mess, and it's Ranger <Player> to the rescue! Rolan's wife will explain the particulars of the mess you've agreed to clean up.
StartText.70: You must complete a mission for Dzuhallag.
StartText.8: You need to perform a service for a peleng named Peleng Piile fon Yile. He'll fill you in on the details. You were given quite a strange task by maloqs from planet <FromPlanet>, don't you think?
StartText.9: You must deliver a small parcel from the Tanzupar corporation to your employer's agent, waiting for you at a spaceport, and secure a note confirming the job is done. Easy as pie!
